claims.content: The Auctioneer uses the system to edit the details of or remove existing scheduled or currently running auctions.

goal.raw_text: The Auctioneer uses the system to edit the details of or remove existing scheduled or currently running auctions.

claims.content: Auctioneer
There must be existing scheduled or currently running auctions in the system for the Auctioneer to edit or remove.
The Auctioneer must have access to the 'View / Edit Current & Scheduled Auctions Page' to initiate the search for auctions to modify.

The system must enable the Auctioneer to search for products based on criteria such as auction status (scheduled/running), product ID, customer email, dates, cost, product type, or duration to identify items for editing or removal.

The Auctioneer searches for existing scheduled or currently running auctions using criteria such as auction status, product ID, customer email, dates, cost, product type, or duration on the 'View / Edit Current & Scheduled Auctions Page' to identify items for editing or removal.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer searches for existing scheduled or currently running auctions using criteria such as auction status, product ID, customer email, dates, cost, product type, or duration on the 'View / Edit Current & Scheduled Auctions Page' to identify items for editing or removal.

claims.content: The Auctioneer accesses the 'View / Edit Current & Scheduled Auctions Page' to initiate the process.
The Auctioneer enters search criteria (such as auction status, product ID, customer email, dates, cost, product type, or duration) in the Search Section.
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Find Product' button to execute the search.
The system displays the matching auctions in the Search Results Section with columns for Action, Image, Product ID, Auction ID, Description, bids, costs, times, and other attributes.
The Auctioneer selects the specific auction items to be edited or removed by checking the boxes in the 'Action' column (or using 'Choose All').

The Auctioneer selects the desired operation from the scrolling 'Action' list box located under the search results (options include 'Remove checked items', 'Edit durations', 'Edit bid increments', 'Edit reserve amounts', 'Apply ending/starting time', or 'Create grouping/event').

If the action requires specific parameters (e.g., applying a time or event profile), the Auctioneer configures these settings (e.g., selecting a time from a dropdown or an event profile from a list box and clicking 'Apply').
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Apply Changes' button to finalize and save the edits or removals to the selected auctions.
If the Auctioneer attempts to create an auction with the same starting and ending date/time, the system displays an error message and highlights (color-codes) the offending data.
The Auctioneer can choose to cancel the operation at any time before applying changes by clicking the 'Cancel' button.

If the Auctioneer tries to apply an event profile restricted to a specific product category (e.g., 'Apply to Gemstones Only') to a grouping of items from a different category (e.g., jewelry), the system generates an error message indicating the profile can only be applied to products in the specified category.
The selected auction items are removed from the auction if the 'Remove checked items from this auction' action was applied.
The durations of the selected auction items are updated if the 'Edit durations' action was applied.
The bid increments of the selected auction items are updated if the 'Edit bid increments' action was applied.
The reserve amounts of the selected auction items are updated if the 'Edit reserve amounts' action was applied.
The ending or starting times of the selected auction items are updated if the 'Apply ending time to all' or 'Apply starting time to all' action was applied.
The selected auction items are associated with a new grouping or event profile if the 'Create grouping / event' or event profile application action was applied.
The changes are saved and reflected in the system after the Auctioneer clicks the 'Apply Changes' button.
